definitions.legal_action_count: number of legal commit actions, positive integer, unnormalized
definitions.remaining_demand_mean: mean of normalized lowest remaining demand of visible unfinished objects, [0,1]
definitions.remaining_demand_std: population std of that same demand list, [0,0.5]
definitions.resource_commitment_mean: mean of normalized committed shares over all defined carriers, [0,1]
definitions.resource_commitment_std: population std of that same carrier list, [0,0.5]
definitions.action_delta_mean: mean normalized partial-objective increment over all current legal actions, [0,1]
definitions.action_delta_std: population std of that same action list, [0,0.5]
definitions.recent_delta_mean: mean of last up to 10 actually committed normalized increments, [0,1]; first None
definitions.recent_delta_std: population std of that same history window, [0,0.5]; first None
definitions.previous_h_token: last committed H category; first None; not a quality rank
definitions.has_history: whether a real action has been committed, bool

fjsp.demand: unfinished jobs: sum of remaining operation minimum durations / B
fjsp.resource: all machines: ready time / B, unused machines zero
fjsp.scale: B=sum of each operation maximum eligible duration; Pmax=instance maximum duration
fjsp.visibility: all jobs, eligible machines and processing times known before solve
fjsp.cost: one-time O(total alternatives) preprocessing; each observation O(jobs+machines+actions+10)

tsp.decisions: n-1 next-city choices, start 0; forced return excluded from history
tsp.demand: each unvisited city: min distance to another unvisited city or start / dmax
tsp.scale: dmax=max distance in fixed symmetric nonnegative matrix; dmax>0
tsp.visibility: whole distance matrix public; no continuation or reference route read
tsp.cost: O(n^2) precheck; each observation O(unvisited^2+n+10); reuse matrix

obp.decisions: N publicly known from start; each arrival is one placement
obp.demand: singleton current item size / bin capacity, std=0 available
obp.resource: all opened bins used capacity / capacity, full bins included; empty list missing
obp.delta: 0 for fitting old bins; if none fits exactly one new-bin action with delta=1
obp.scale: public fixed bin capacity; bin-count increments already 0 or 1
obp.visibility: only current item, public N, opened bins and past actions; no future items
obp.cost: each observation O(opened bins+10); no lookahead

spec.timing: enumerate legal actions -> observe -> U chooses one H -> only chosen H scores -> commit -> history
spec.statistics: population std; same list for each mean/std pair; singleton std zero; no history padding
spec.missing: None+availability false only for absent objects: first history and OBP unopened resources
spec.constants: constant/redundant/singleton zero is available; no disabled groups in scheme A
spec.invalid: reject invalid scales, nonfinite or out-of-range inputs; never treat invalid as missing
spec.score_interface: final mean((cost-reference)/reference), minimize; no quality labels in observation
spec.numeric_tolerance: packet scalar validation tolerates 1e-12 for floating arithmetic; never clips
